# KwanCode Harness 0.11.33 - native plugin overlay

This overlay promotes the verified R33 additions without replacing the recoverable R21 plugin.
It adds six precise skills, an embedded Virtuous Handoff 0.2.2 runtime, runtime discovery at
session start and a PreCompact continuity intervention. Local hooks remain Codex-host features;
universal ChatGPT surfaces receive only the plugin/skill layers they actually support.

The first real handoff passed 20/20 strengthened gates after reading seven sources, 26 pages and
221 turns to EOF. Thirty-three host-bounded tool outputs remain disclosed and must be recovered
from original artifacts when their missing bytes matter. No PHL training is included or executed.
